title: Limitation and Account Recovery Schedule — Pocketwire Personal Account
content:
The figures that apply to limitations, risk closures and security-lock recoveries on a Pocketwire Personal Account are set per plan.

| Plan | Document response window (calendar days after the limitation) | Document review target (business days) | Fund hold after a risk closure (calendar days) | Recovery cooling-off (full hours after the security lock) | Identity re-verification method for recovery | Post-recovery weekly send cap (USD) | Post-recovery period (calendar days after the recovered date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Lite | 21 | 5 | 180 | 72 | SMS and email codes | 299.99 | 7 |
| Pocketwire Core | 21 | 5 | 180 | 48 | Government ID and selfie | 1000.00 | 7 |
| Pocketwire Plus | 21 | 5 | 180 | 48 | Government ID and selfie | 1500.00 | 7 |
| Pocketwire Prime | 30 | 3 | 180 | 24 | Government ID and selfie | 2500.00 | 5 |
| Pocketwire Onyx | 30 | 2 | 180 | 24 | Government ID and selfie | 5000.00 | 3 |
| Pocketwire Summit | 30 | 2 | 180 | 12 | Government ID and selfie | 10000.00 | 3 |

### Column meanings

- **Document response window** — the calendar days after the limitation was placed within which the customer must submit the requested documents.
- **Document review target** — the service target for deciding submitted limitation documents, in business days.
- **Fund hold** — the calendar days the remaining balance of an account closed for risk is held before release to the customer.
- **Recovery cooling-off** — the minimum full hours between the security lock and completion of account recovery.
- **Re-verification method** — the identity re-verification the customer must pass before recovery can be approved: SMS and email codes, or government ID and selfie.
- **Post-recovery weekly send cap** — the rolling 7-day send cap that replaces the effective weekly send limit during the post-recovery period.
- **Post-recovery period** — the calendar days after the recovered date during which the post-recovery send cap applies.

Pocketwire Lite is the only plan recovered by SMS and email codes; every other plan requires government ID and selfie.
